notes.title: Version 1.2.0
notes.content:
-Fixed a bug that charging is not restarted in some scenes when automatic shot is disabled.
-Fixed the problem that the marker is not displayed on the lockable target.
-Adjusted the movement and attack of some enemies
-Fixed a bug that the player moves regardless of the input in some scenes.
-Fixed a scrolling bug in the alien species databook

notes.title: Version 1.2.0
notes.content:
-Improved game performance
-Adjusted the difficulty
-Changed the placement, behavior, HP, etc. of some objects.
-Fixed some bugs in the production and made changes.
-Fixed a bug in the behavior of player.
-Changed some UI and text
-Changed to send the score without opening the ranking
-Fixed other bugs

notes.title: Version 1.1.8
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.1.8[/b]
-Changed to record if the score at the time of revival (continue) is high.
[b]Version 1.1.7[/b]
-Adjusted the placement and behavior of some enemies and fixed bugs
-Changed some production expressions
-Adjusted the Lock-on Shot speed
-Other minor bug fixes are included

notes.title: Version 1.1.4
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.1.4[/b]

-Fixed the problem that the game was restarted without the continuation screen disappearing.
-Fixed a bug where the position would rise more than necessary when firing a charge shot near the ground.
-Adjusted the range where lock-on occurs

notes.content:

notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.1.0[/b]

- Supports Steam Input for gamepad operations. You can continue to use the traditional input system by disabling Steam Input from the Steam settings.

- Adjusted the volume balance of some sound effects.

- Fixed some text.

- Fixed the behavior of some enemy objects.

- Other minor bugs have been fixed.
